summary: CervoMed Inc. filed an 8-K announcing the closing of a registered direct offering of 2,500,000 shares at $4.00 per share, yielding $10 million in gross proceeds. H.C. Wainwright acted as exclusive placement agent. The offering was priced at-the-market under Nasdaq rules. Net proceeds will be used for working capital and general corporate purposes. This is a routine capital raise, not a special situation. No special-situation category applies.
